name: Genotypes · Potions
description: Two ways to write a creature's genes into your body: the $(4)permanent potion$(0) (genotype absorption) and the $(4)breakthrough potion$(0) (temporary awakening) — breakthrough splits into three directions: Balance / Surge / Endure, alongside the gene manager and rejection serum.$(br)Start with $(4)Genotype Potions Guide$(0), then check recipe data in $(4)Three Breakthrough Modes$(0).
